questions.question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '2'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85f7592b15d905fa90953d58dfb195eed01cc5dba7bbea7c88661f5f399bb967.png]
questions.solution:
In this case, we make two different arrangements of the digits from the positions of the dice. We note the digits in clockwise direction starting from the common digit. In both the arrangements, the digits written after the common digit are opposite to each other. 

 5 is the common digit in both the side, so the clockwise order of the digits is 

 5, 1, 4 (in first dice)

 5, 6, 3 (in the second dice)

Therefore, 1 is opposite to 6, 4 is opposite to 3 and 5 is opposite to 2(remaining digit).

Hence, the correct answer is .**5**

questions.question: A cube of 4 cm size is painted green on all six faces. It is cut into smaller cubes of 1 cm size. How many cubes are there with 3 green faces?
questions.solution:
The given cube is cut into smaller cubes of 1 cm each.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ddd5de95ac54fb049f136fe0b62b2d2da0cd0ff8ea4c5628bd223f5310d27abd.png] 

When painted on all six faces, the corner cubes are the only cubes with 3 green faces.

The number of corners for a cube = 8 (4 (front) + 4 (back))

Hence, the number of cubes with 3 green faces is 8.

Hence, the correct answer is **"8"**.

questions.solution:
**TRICK:**

In first and second dice, we have common element i.e. C

We will rotate the elements either in clockwise or anticlockwise direction to get the opposite paired elements.

On rotating the elements in clockwise direction, we get,

First dice - C, B, A

Second dice - C, D, E

Thus, we can say that A is opposite to E.

Hence, **E **is correct.
